logic_errors.description: AST alpha canonicalization is not injective: real bound identifiers e/t are renamed to fixed TABLE/CACHE sentinels, but already-spelled, unbound TABLE/CACHE identifiers remain unchanged and compare equal. The exact loader gate therefore accepts incorrect binding relationships and is not fail-closed as required.
logic_errors.reproduction: Read original public CI APP phone-sync.js (table=e, cache=t); replace only loader module invocation callee object e with TABLE, or cached lookup object t with CACHE, using parsed AST source offsets. Both assertCompiledSdkShape(mutant) returned true, although TABLE/CACHE are not the corresponding bound SDK table/cache variables. Mutants were in-memory only.
logic_errors.boundary: This proves a shape-validator false positive, not a demonstrated full HOST pass or native/security exploit. Existing HOST VM may reject an unbound identifier at execution time; that does not repair the promised exact AST gate.
logic_errors.recommendation: Make identifier canonicalization binding-aware and collision-free (distinct structured binding tokens rather than ordinary identifier names), and add these incorrect-binding negative cases. Do not modify original APP bytes.
